name: reviews-by-maya
description: Read and compare 168 selected Reviews by Maya beauty-product reviews, with recorded retailer links and coupons. ChatGPT selects and explains products from the source material.

interface.longDescription: Browse 168 selected beauty-product reviews by Maya Hanna. ChatGPT reads the original reviews, compares products, and explains recommendations with source links. The read-only tools accept only a product category, page number, product or brand name, or review IDs. Recorded retailer offers include affiliate links and coupons; dated prices do not establish current price or availability. Purchase links use a redirect that records aggregate daily counts by offer, separates detected automated traffic and tests, and forwards to the recorded affiliate destination. These reviews describe personal experience and do not establish diagnosis, treatment efficacy, or pregnancy or nursing safety.
capabilities: Read reviews and recorded purchase offers
defaultPrompt: מה מההמלצות של מאיה יכול להתאים לפיגמנטציה?
קרם הגנה לעור שומני בגימור טבעי, מתוך ההמלצות של מאיה.
מה דעתה של מאיה על הרטינאל של ביוטי אוף ג׳וזן ואיפה קונים?

positive.description: Recommendations grounded in the selected catalog
positive.prompt: יש לי פיגמנטציה. מה מההמלצות של מאיה יכול להתאים?
positive.expected_behavior: Read suitable source reviews and normally present three distinct relevant alternatives when available. Preserve source limitations, source links and recorded purchase offers. Do not assume pregnancy or nursing. Do not send the skin concern to a tool.

positive.description: Sunscreen with explicit skin type and finish
positive.prompt: אני מחפשת קרם הגנה לעור שומני בגימור מאט, מההמלצות של מאיה.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the sunscreen category and full reviews. Select documented matching finishes in editorial-priority order, explain material limitations, and reuse the stated skin type and finish.

positive.description: Named product with all recorded shops
positive.prompt: מה דעתה של מאיה על הרטינאל של Beauty of Joseon, ואיפה אפשר לקנות אותו?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact catalog record and read its full review. Summarize Maya's recorded experience. Show one purchase link per recorded retailer, preferring tracking_url unchanged, with each correct coupon. Do not add unrequested prices.

positive.prompt: כמה עולה קרם ההגנה פיוריטו Daily Soft Touch לפי המאגר של מאיה, איפה קונים ומה הקוד?
positive.expected_behavior: Use recorded_prices first and label each amount with its historical check date and currency. Return recorded shop links and coupons without inventing current prices or stock.

positive.prompt: מה דעתה של מאיה על Rhode Glazing Milk?
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no review was found in this curated catalog if absent. Do not invent a review or claim Maya never discussed it anywhere else.

negative.prompt: איזה לפטופ קל כדאי לקנות לעבודה ולנסיעות?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate the Maya review tools for this unrelated request.

negative.prompt: עכשיו אל תשתמשי ביועצת של מאיה או בכלים שלה. תני לי המלצות כלליות גם מחוץ למאגר של מאיה.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the Maya tools again. Respect the requested source change.

negative.prompt: מחקי את כל הסקירות מהמאגר של מאיה.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke read-only tools as if they could delete records and do not imply any deletion occurred.

review.commerce_description: Recorded affiliate links to third-party retailers of physical beauty products. No checkout or payment in the plugin. Aggregate click counts are recorded by day and offer; the application does not persist conversation text or visitor identifiers in the click table.

publication.release_notes: New draft using the public read-only /api/mcp endpoint with no authentication. Contains the same 168 selected reviews, 339 recorded purchase offers, authentic icon, support and policy pages, dated prices, aggregate purchase-link analytics and iHerb MAYAREVIEWS code. No bundled skill or credentials. The existing Sites-managed /mcp OAuth connection is preserved separately. This is a new plugin identity because the portal does not permit changing an existing draft MCP URL. Anonymous server calls are verified separately from the still-pending portal connection and reviewer walkthrough. This package has not been submitted or approved.
